title: Peruvian national extradited to US over call-centre scheme impersonating officials
date_note: The DOJ release is dated 24 November and states no earlier extradition day.
geo_basis: Federal court in Miami, where the DOJ release says she made her initial appearance
summary: The US Department of Justice says Karount Jannet Toledo Vazquez of Lima, Peru, was extradited and made an initial appearance in federal court in Miami. The indictment alleges she and co-conspirators ran a Peruvian call center from at least 2013 through 2018, impersonating police, US federal officials and university representatives to pressure Spanish-speaking US consumers into paying. An indictment is only an allegation.
plain: A Peruvian woman has been extradited to the US. Prosecutors allege her call center posed as officials to scare Spanish-speaking consumers into paying. She is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
exec: The DOJ alleges a Peruvian call center impersonated US officials to extort US consumers; a defendant is now in US court.

validation.note: Primary: the Department of Justice's own press release was read.

review.note: Compared title, name, 24 Nov date, 2013-2018 call center, impersonation, Miami appearance and allegation wording against the DOJ release
